gold_transcript: Two-year-old female brought in by mother with complaint of dry cough for three days, evolving with fever last night reaching one hundred and one point three degrees. On lung auscultation presents diffuse bilateral wheezing, subcostal retraction signs and intercostal pulling. SpO2 ninety-two percent on room air. Diagnosis: acute bronchiolitis. Prescribe nebulization with racemic epinephrine and normal saline every four hours. Maintain oral hydration. Counsel on warning signs for immediate return.

Thirty-five-year-old male arrived at urgent care with abdominal pain in the right lower quadrant, onset twelve hours ago, associated with nausea and one episode of food vomiting. Physical exam: presents muscular guarding, positive Blumberg sign, painful sudden decompression. No fever at the moment. Suspected acute appendicitis. Order complete blood count, urea, creatinine, beta-HCG levels and abdominal ultrasound. Maintain absolute fasting. Large-caliber IV access with normal saline at one hundred twenty-five milliliters per hour.

Pediatric follow-up, five-year-old, for control of acute otitis media. Mother reports improvement in ear pain, but child still presents low-grade fever. On otoscopy, tympanic membrane still shows hyperemia and bulging, but less than at the previous visit. Prescribe amoxicillin five hundred milligrams every eight hours for seven more days. Acetaminophen drops if fever above one hundred point four degrees. Return in five days or sooner if worsens.

Seven-year-old male, twenty-two kilograms, presents with asthma exacerbation. Diffuse wheezing on auscultation, prolonged expiration, subcostal retraction. SpO2 ninety-one percent on room air. Started nebulization with albuterol two point five milligrams and ipratropium bromide two hundred fifty micrograms every twenty minutes for three doses. Prednisolone two milligrams per kilogram oral single dose. Mother instructed on correct inhaler technique with spacer. Return in twenty-four hours or sooner if respiratory distress worsens.

Forty-two-year-old female with urinary tract infection, third episode in six months. Urinalysis shows positive nitrites and leukocyte esterase. Urine culture pending. Prescribe amoxicillin-clavulanate eight hundred seventy-five milligrams twice daily for seven days. Acetaminophen for fever and discomfort. Instruct to drink at least two liters of water daily and void after sexual intercourse. Return with culture results in one week.

Eighteen-month-old, twelve kilograms, presenting with croup. Barking cough, inspiratory stridor at rest, mild subcostal retraction. SpO2 ninety-four percent. Administered nebulized racemic epinephrine zero point five milliliters in three milliliters normal saline. Oral dexamethasone zero point six milligrams per kilogram single dose. Mother counseled on warning signs: increased work of breathing, drooling, inability to drink. Return immediately if any of these develop, otherwise follow up in twenty-four hours.

Six-month-old infant, seven kilograms, with first episode of bronchiolitis. Runny nose for two days, now with cough and tachypnea. Diffuse wheezing and fine crackles on auscultation. SpO2 eighty-nine percent on room air. Started nasal suctioning and supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula at one liter per minute. Feedings reduced to sixty milliliters every three hours. No antibiotics indicated for viral bronchiolitis. Admit for observation.

Ten-year-old, thirty-two kilograms, with exacerbation of reactive airway disease. Diffuse wheezing, decreased air entry bilaterally. SpO2 ninety-three percent. Started albuterol nebulization two point five milligrams every twenty minutes times three. Prednisolone one milligram per kilogram oral daily for five days. Peak flow measured at one hundred eighty liters per minute, sixty percent of predicted. Mother taught spacer technique. Return in two days or sooner if no improvement.

Three-year-old, fourteen kilograms, with fever and rash. Maculopapular rash starting on face and spreading to trunk. Koplik spots on buccal mucosa. Temperature one hundred and three point two degrees. Diagnosis: measles. Supportive care with acetaminophen ten milligrams per kilogram every six hours for fever. Vitamin A supplementation. Isolate from other children. Notify public health authorities. Return if respiratory distress or altered mental status develops.

Four-year-old, sixteen kilograms, with pharyngitis. Positive rapid strep test. Prescribe amoxicillin forty milligrams per kilogram per day divided twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen for pain and fever. No aspirin. Return if rash develops or symptoms worsen after forty-eight hours. No school for twenty-four hours after starting antibiotics. Follow up if not improved in three days.

Nine-month-old, eight and a half kilograms, with acute gastroenteritis. Four episodes of vomiting and six watery stools in last twelve hours. Mild dehydration, normal skin turgor, moist mucous membranes. Started oral rehydration solution five milliliters every five minutes, increase as tolerated. No anti-diarrheal medications. Continue breastfeeding. Zinc supplementation ten milligrams daily for ten days. Return if decreased urine output, lethargy, or blood in stool.

Twelve-year-old, forty-five kilograms, with acute ankle sprain. Unable to bear weight, swelling over lateral malleolus. X-ray negative for fracture. Diagnosis: grade two lateral ankle sprain. Rest, ice, compression, elevation. Acetaminophen six hundred fifty milligrams every six hours for pain. No weight bearing for forty-eight hours. Ankle brace. Physical therapy referral. Return in one week or sooner if worsening.

Fifteen-month-old, ten kilograms, with acute conjunctivitis. Bilateral purulent discharge, injected conjunctiva. Prescribe erythromycin ophthalmic ointment four times daily for seven days. Acetaminophen if discomfort. Warm compresses. Hand hygiene emphasized. No contact lens wear. Return if vision changes, severe pain, or no improvement in forty-eight hours.

Five-year-old, nineteen kilograms, with acute sinusitis. Purulent nasal discharge, facial pain, fever one hundred point six degrees for four days. Prescribe amoxicillin forty-five milligrams per kilogram twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen for fever. Nasal saline spray. Return if worsening after forty-eight hours or if symptoms persist beyond ten days. ENT referral if recurrent.

Eleven-year-old, thirty-eight kilograms, with exacerbation of eczema. Pruritic erythematous patches on flexor surfaces, lichenified plaques on wrists. Started topical hydrocortisone two point five percent twice daily. Oral diphenhydramine twenty-five milligrams at bedtime for itching. Moisturize frequently. Avoid hot showers and fragranced soaps. Dermatology referral if no improvement in two weeks.

Thirteen-year-old, fifty kilograms, with migraine headache. Throbbing right temporal pain, photophobia, phonophobia, nausea. No aura. Prescribe ibuprofen six hundred milligrams at onset, may repeat in six hours. Acetaminophen one thousand milligrams as alternative. Rest in dark quiet room. Return if headache pattern changes, new neurological symptoms, or no relief with medication. Neurology referral if recurrent.

Sixteen-year-old, fifty-five kilograms, with acute appendicitis. Right lower quadrant pain, positive Blumberg sign, leukocytosis. Taken to operating room for laparoscopic appendectomy. Procedure uncomplicated. Postoperative orders: clear liquid diet advancing as tolerated, acetaminophen six hundred fifty milligrams every six hours for pain, cefazolin one gram IV every eight hours for twenty-four hours. Ambulate on postoperative day one. Discharge when tolerating diet and pain controlled.

Eight-year-old, twenty-six kilograms, with pneumonia. Fever one hundred and two degrees, productive cough, tachypnea. Chest x-ray shows right lower lobe consolidation. SpO2 ninety-four percent on room air. Started amoxicillin ninety milligrams per kilogram per day divided twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen for fever. Encourage fluids. Return if worsening breathing, persistent fever beyond forty-eight hours, or lethargy.

Two-year-old, twelve kilograms, with hand-foot-and-mouth disease. Vesicular lesions on palms, soles, and oral mucosa. Low-grade fever. Supportive care: acetaminophen ten milligrams per kilogram every six hours for fever or discomfort. Maintain hydration with cold fluids and soft foods. Avoid citrus and spicy foods. Return if unable to drink, signs of dehydration, or fever above one hundred and three degrees persists beyond three days.

Fourteen-year-old, fifty-two kilograms, with acute tonsillitis. Exudative tonsils, tender anterior cervical lymphadenopathy, fever one hundred and one degrees. Rapid strep positive. Prescribe amoxicillin fifty milligrams per kilogram per day divided twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen for pain and fever. Warm salt water gargles. No school until twenty-four hours of antibiotics and fever-free. Return if no improvement in forty-eight hours.

Twenty-nine-year-old female, sixty-eight kilograms, presents with cough and fever for five days. Productive cough with yellow sputum, pleuritic chest pain. Temperature one hundred point eight degrees. Lung exam: crackles in right lower lobe. Chest x-ray confirms right lower lobe pneumonia. Started amoxicillin-clavulanate eight hundred seventy-five milligrams twice daily for seven days. Acetaminophen one thousand milligrams every six hours for fever. Return if no improvement in forty-eight hours.

Thirty-four-year-old male, eighty-two kilograms, with acute diverticulitis. Left lower quadrant pain, fever one hundred point two degrees, leukocytosis. CT scan shows colonic wall thickening with pericolic fat stranding. Started amoxicillin-clavulanate plus metronidazole. Clear liquid diet. IV fluids. Pain control with acetaminophen one thousand milligrams every six hours. Surgery consult if no improvement in twenty-four hours or if complicated disease.

Twenty-six-year-old female, fifty-five kilograms, with suspected pyelonephritis. Right flank pain, dysuria, fever one hundred point four degrees, nausea. Urinalysis shows pyuria and bacteriuria. Urine culture sent. Started amoxicillin-clavulanate eight hundred seventy-five milligrams twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen for fever and pain. Hydration encouraged. Return if worsening, persistent fever, or vomiting. Repeat urine culture in one week.

Thirty-eight-year-old male, ninety kilograms, with acute bronchitis. Cough for ten days, initially dry now productive of clear sputum. No fever. Chest exam: scattered wheezing, normal percussion. SpO2 ninety-seven percent. No antibiotics indicated. Supportive care: acetaminophen as needed, increase fluid intake, humidifier. Return if fever develops, shortness of breath, or cough persists beyond three weeks.

Forty-five-year-old female, seventy kilograms, with exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Dyspnea, increased sputum purulence, wheezing. SpO2 eighty-eight percent on room air. Started albuterol-ipratropium nebulization every four hours. Oral prednisolone forty milligrams daily for five days. Supplemental oxygen two liters per minute via nasal cannula. Chest x-ray to rule out pneumonia. Return if no improvement in twenty-four hours.

Twenty-two-year-old male, seventy-five kilograms, with allergic rhinitis exacerbation. Sneezing, rhinorrhea, nasal congestion, itchy eyes. Prescribe cetirizine ten milligrams daily and fluticasone propionate nasal spray fifty micrograms per nostril twice daily. Saline nasal irrigation twice daily. Avoid known triggers. Return if symptoms worsen or if no improvement in two weeks. Allergy testing referral if recurrent.

Thirty-one-year-old female, sixty-two kilograms, with acute otitis externa. Swimmer's ear, severe otalgia, tragal tenderness, erythematous canal. Prescribe ciprofloxacin-hydrocortisone otic drops four drops twice daily for seven days. Acetaminophen six hundred fifty milligrams every six hours for pain. Keep ear dry. No swimming. Return if worsening or no improvement in forty-eight hours.

Fifty-year-old male, eighty-five kilograms, with gout flare. First metatarsophalangeal joint swollen, erythematous, exquisitely tender. Started colchicine zero point six milligrams twice daily until symptoms improve, then once daily. Acetaminophen one thousand milligrams every six hours for pain. No NSAIDs due to chronic kidney disease. Allopurinol to start after flare resolves. Hydration encouraged. Return if no improvement in one week.

Twenty-seven-year-old female, fifty-eight kilograms, with acute sinusitis. Facial pain, purulent nasal discharge, fever one hundred point two degrees for five days. Started amoxicillin-clavulanate eight hundred seventy-five milligrams twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen one thousand milligrams every six hours. Nasal saline irrigation. Return if worsening after forty-eight hours or if symptoms persist beyond ten days.

Thirty-three-year-old male, seventy-eight kilograms, with community-acquired pneumonia. Fever one hundred and three degrees, productive cough, pleuritic chest pain. SpO2 ninety-two percent on room air. Chest x-ray shows left upper lobe consolidation. Started amoxicillin-clavulanate plus azithromycin. Acetaminophen for fever. Oxygen two liters nasal cannula. IV fluids. Return if worsening after forty-eight hours. Reassess at seventy-two hours.

Nineteen-year-old female, fifty kilograms, with pharyngitis. Sore throat, fever one hundred point two degrees, tender anterior cervical nodes. No cough. Rapid strep negative. Likely viral. Symptomatic treatment: acetaminophen six hundred fifty milligrams every six hours, warm salt water gargles, throat lozenges. Return if worsening, rash, or if not improved in five days. Throat culture sent.

Forty-one-year-old male, ninety-five kilograms, with acute low back strain. Lifting injury, pain radiates to left buttock, no neurologic deficits. Straight leg raise negative. Started acetaminophen one thousand milligrams every six hours. Muscle relaxant cyclobenzaprine five milligrams at bedtime for three days. Heat and stretching. No heavy lifting. Return if new neurologic symptoms, bowel or bladder changes, or no improvement in two weeks.

Twenty-four-year-old female, sixty kilograms, with acute cystitis. Dysuria, frequency, urgency, suprapubic pain. Urinalysis positive for nitrites and leukocyte esterase. Prescribe amoxicillin-clavulanate eight hundred seventy-five milligrams twice daily for seven days. Acetaminophen for discomfort. Phenazopyridine two hundred milligrams three times daily for two days for dysuria. Increase fluid intake. Return if fever, flank pain, or worsening.

Thirty-seven-year-old male, eighty-eight kilograms, with acute pancreatitis. Severe epigastric pain radiating to back, nausea, vomiting. Lipase three times upper limit of normal. CT shows pancreatic inflammation. NPO, IV fluids, pain control with acetaminophen one thousand milligrams IV every six hours. No NSAIDs. Surgery consult. Ranson criteria calculated. Monitor for complications. Return if worsening.

Twenty-eight-year-old female, sixty-four kilograms, with acute tonsillitis. Exudative tonsils, fever one hundred point four degrees, tender cervical lymph nodes. Rapid strep positive. Prescribe amoxicillin fifty milligrams per kilogram per day divided twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen for fever and pain. Warm salt water gargles. No school until twenty-four hours of antibiotics and afebrile. Return if rash or no improvement in forty-eight hours.

Forty-three-year-old male, seventy-six kilograms, with cellulitis of right lower extremity. Erythema, warmth, swelling, tenderness. No abscess. Started amoxicillin-clavulanate eight hundred seventy-five milligrams twice daily for seven days. Acetaminophen for pain. Elevate leg. Mark borders. Return if worsening, fever, or red streaking. Recheck in forty-eight hours.

Sixteen-year-old female, fifty-four kilograms, with acute gastroenteritis. Vomiting and diarrhea for twelve hours. Mild dehydration. Started oral rehydration solution. Acetaminophen for fever. No anti-diarrheal agents. BRAT diet as tolerated. Return if unable to keep fluids down, blood in stool, or signs of severe dehydration. Zinc supplement ten milligrams daily for ten days.

Thirty-nine-year-old female, sixty-seven kilograms, with acute migraine. Throbbing unilateral headache, photophobia, phonophobia, nausea. Prescribe acetaminophen one thousand milligrams and ibuprofen six hundred milligrams now. Rest in dark room. Anti-nausea medication ondansetron four milligrams if needed. Return if headache pattern changes, new neurologic symptoms, or not improved in two hours. Neurology referral if recurrent.

Twenty-one-year-old male, seventy-two kilograms, with acute ankle sprain. Inversion injury, unable to bear weight, swelling over lateral malleolus. X-ray negative for fracture. Grade two sprain. RICE protocol. Acetaminophen six hundred fifty milligrams every six hours. No weight bearing for forty-eight hours. Ankle brace. Physical therapy referral. Return in one week or sooner if worsening.

Thirty-six-year-old female, fifty-nine kilograms, with acute sinusitis. Facial pain, purulent nasal discharge, fever one hundred point two degrees for six days. Started amoxicillin-clavulanate eight hundred seventy-five milligrams twice daily for ten days. Acetaminophen one thousand milligrams every six hours for fever and pain. Nasal saline irrigation. Return if worsening after forty-eight hours or symptoms persist beyond ten days. ENT referral if recurrent.
